text: “I made my report at the office,” he said. Holmes took a half-sovereign from his pocket and played with it pensively. “We thought that we should like to hear it all from your own lips,” he said. “I shall be most happy to tell you anything I can,” the constable answered with his eyes upon the little golden disk. “Just let us hear it all in your own way as it occurred.” Rance sat down on the horsehair sofa, and knitted his brows as though determined not to omit anything in his narrative.
